label: Contradiction-11
title: K-011: Is the fix in PHP 8.5.12 incomplete?
description: The report and the answer are about different things: the Fediverse post describes some flaw in 8.5.12; the PHP security team says it is a separate crash bug of minimal impact, not a way around the RCE fix. The answer came at 09:11 UTC on 22 October, after the vault's copy of the thread (which stops at 22/2), so the site still says PHP has not answered. Open only until the reply is captured; then it should be marked explained and the claim re-graded.
